Retrieval stage latency (p95)
panels.description: embed = Ollama nomic-embed-text, vector_search = Chroma, graph = Neo4j lookup + candidate scoring.

panels.title: Grounding: verified vs unverified claims
panels.description: Each section/rupee claim in an answer, checked against the retrieved legal text.

panels.title: Guardrail decisions
panels.description: allowed = clean question; redacted = PII (Aadhaar/phone/plate/email) removed; blocked = injection or illegal request.

panels.title: Retrieval top similarity score (p10 / median)
panels.description: Best cosine similarity per query. A falling trend means users ask things the legal corpus does not cover (query drift).
